notes.notes:

notes.title: TOTAL RELOAD Demo Release
notes.notes:
In TOTAL RELOAD you have to learn to “think with wires,” or in other words, understand that by temporarily supplying power to various objects you can get to previously inaccessible locations. It is difficult to feel the full depth of this game mechanics from a video, so we released a demo that contains 20% of the locations from the full version of the game. In the demo version, you will be able to fully experience what it means to “think with wires” and learn how to interact with some devices: Quantum Transporters, Energy Transmitters, Sensor Grids, Energy Cubes, Energy Converters.

You will be able to start playing the full version of the game from where you finished playing the demo.
